commitResults.messageTitle: Fix names, remark access, and documentation
commitResults.messageBody:
Names with punctuation or accented letters are rejected, and slash
words in names stop Tab completion. Long remarks cannot always be
read in full, and several documentation statements do not match
the application.

Accept Unicode letters, combining marks, and common name punctuation
through shared validation while preserving normalization and limits.
Keep valid slash words in names during Tab completion.

Show complete remarks in the scrollable details panel and provide a
selectable, read-only viewer for long unbroken text.

Correct migration instructions and the delete and tag search diagrams.
Add regression coverage for parsing, completion, persistence, and
rendered remark access.

Validate with 632 passing tests, Checkstyle, coverage, and packaging.
Prepare TutorLink v1.6 release and acknowledgements
